   **Format:** `key1:value1|value2,key2:value3`

   - Single values: `data_source_classification:repository,cf.search.name:archive`
   - Multiple values: `data_source_classification:repository|aggregator`

   **IMPORTANT:** Duplicate keys are not allowed (use pipe `|` to separate multiple values)

   **Attribute Filters:**
- `data_source_classification`: repository, aggregator, scientific database, journal archive, publisher archive, cris system
- `identifiers.value`: data source identifier

**Convenience Filters:**
- `cf.search.name`: name search (official and English name)

   - Multiple values: `product_type:literature|research data|research software`

- `product_type`: literature, research data, research software, other
- `identifiers.id`: product identifier (DOI, arXiv, etc.)

- `funding.grant_number`: funding grant number

- `cf.search.title`: title search
